fields.name: krb5Conf
fields.label: krb5.conf
fields.placeholder:
[libdefaults]
  default_realm = CDP.EXAMPLE.COM
[realms]
  CDP.EXAMPLE.COM = {
    kdc = kdc.cdp.example.com
  }
[domain_realm]
  .cdp.example.com = CDP.EXAMPLE.COM
fields.help: Optional. Paste the krb5.conf for this platform's realm(s). When set, services deployed against this context mount THIS krb5.conf (with in-cluster hostname canonicalization disabled) instead of the hosting cluster's /etc/krb5.conf — required when the backend (e.g. CDP) is in a different Kerberos realm than the Ambari cluster.

fields.name: kdcType
fields.label: KDC type
fields.help: Set it to let KDPS create the Kerberos principals and keytabs of the releases deployed with this context, in this platform's KDC (Ambari server does it, through /kerberos/adhoc_keytab). none: give each release an existing keytab Secret instead. KDPS only creates principals named after the release's namespace and never resets an existing one.

fields.name: kdcAdminPrincipal
fields.label: KDC account
fields.help: The account KDPS creates principals with. For a CDP cluster, the account Cloudera Manager uses (Administration > Security > Kerberos Credentials): it already has the rights on Cloudera Manager's organizational unit.

fields.name: kdcAdminPassword
fields.label: KDC account password
fields.help: Kept in Ambari's credential store with the KDC it is for, never in KDPS. Needed again whenever the KDC type, realm, account, LDAPS URL, KDC host or organizational unit changes.

fields.name: kdcLdapUrl
fields.label: Active Directory LDAPS URL
fields.help: Active Directory only; ldaps:// only. Ambari server must trust the AD's certificate authority (ambari-server setup-security, import-certificate).

fields.name: kdcContainerDn
fields.label: Organizational unit
fields.help: Active Directory only: where the release accounts are created. For a CDP cluster, Cloudera Manager's (its Active Directory Suffix setting).

fields.name: kdcEncryptionTypes
fields.label: Encryption types
fields.help: The key types of the keytabs, space-separated. Left empty: AES 256 and AES 128.

fields.name: kdcAdminServerHost
fields.label: Admin server host
fields.help: FreeIPA and MIT only: the kadmin / IPA server. Left empty: the KDC host above.
